chapter_seo_title: Chapter 52: Danyangzi – The Fight Nobody Saw but Li Huowang
chapter_meta_description: Danyangzi descends in horrifying form to slaughter seven Flesh Buddhas, but when the carnage ends, nobody else saw him. Li Huowang discovers his own mouth is torn open—and he feels full.
og_title: The Seven Buddhas Fell—But Li Huowang Was the Only One Fighting
og_description: Li Huowang thinks he's watching Danyangzi tear through the Flesh Buddhas. Then Bai Lingmiao says she didn't see anyone—only Li Huowang, mouth split, stomach full.
twitter_title: Chapter 52 Twist: Danyangzi Never Existed—Li Huowang Was the Monster All Along
twitter_description: Li Huowang witnesses Danyangzi kill seven Buddhas in brutal fashion. Then the others reveal they saw nothing but Li Huowang himself, mouth torn open and feeling inexplicably full.
